elements.label: Figure 12
elements.title: Figure 12: Evolution of Sources of Revenue of Public Universities, 2004 and 2017
elements.content:
Chart type: Clustered column chart
x-axis: Revenue sources (State Subsidy, Tuition, RDI, services, others etc.)
y-axis: Percentage of total revenue (%), range 0 to 80
Legend: 2004 (grey), 2017 (orange)

Data points:
- State Subsidy / 2004: 68
- State Subsidy / 2017: 22
- Tuition / 2004: 26
- Tuition / 2017: 55
- RDI, services, others etc. / 2004: 6
- RDI, services, others etc. / 2017: 23

Comparisons:
- In 2004, State Subsidy was the largest revenue source at 68%, but it fell steeply to 22% in 2017.
- Tuition more than doubled from 26% in 2004 to become the dominant source at 55% in 2017.
- Other sources (RDI, services, others etc.) increased almost fourfold from 6% in 2004 to 23% in 2017.

Source: Authors’ calculations using MOET University Surveys (2004 and 2017).
